competency_statement_fil: BHW bilang tagapagsulong ng kalusugan sa barangay: isinasagawa ang mga gawain sa araling ito ayon sa kasalukuyang lokal na gabay, may paggalang sa pahintulot, privacy at saklaw ng BHW.
competency_statement_en: Barangay health promotion officer: performs the unit tasks using current local guidance, consent, privacy and BHW scope boundaries.

observation_indicators.observable_en: Distinguishes the barrier from a diagnosis and proposes an achievable action with partners.

observation_indicators.not_yet_en: Say she does not care about health because she missed the visit.
